(async()=>{ for(let i=0;i<80;i++){ if(window.__app && __app.player.video.readyState>=2) break; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250)); } __app.player.video.pause(); __app.showTab('together'); document.querySelector('.page[data-page=together] .btn.primary').click(); for(let i=0;i<20;i++){ await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); if(document.querySelector('.invite .code')?.textContent) break; } return 'CODE[' + document.querySelector('.invite .code')?.textContent + ']'; })()

(async()=>{ for(let i=0;i<120;i++){ const m=[...document.querySelectorAll('.modal')].find(x=>/wants to join/.test(x.innerText)); if(m){ [...m.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent==='Allow').click(); return 'allowed'; } await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250)); } return 'no approval prompt'; })()
